verdict.rationale: Lago documents invoice downloads and CSV export from its revenue analytics dashboards. A full API reference and a self-hosted deployment imply programmatic access to billing data, but no documented bulk-export or offboarding feature covers every subscription, invoice and usage record. Nothing in the evidence addresses porting stored payment methods to another provider. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of all subscriptions and usage records, payment-method portability or migration to another provider, independent corroboration of exit/export workflows.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can export every subscription, invoice, and usage record — and port stored payment methods out to another provider — if I choose to leave

citations.quote: You can download invoices or use the invoice object to create your own invoice template.
Build custom dashboards per customer, filter any way you want and export to CSV.
